relevance_note: A clinical-practice review ("this review aims to highlight key principles in our approach to patients with known or suspected HA20") that reports HA20 patients only as aggregate percentages from published reviews and cohorts (Table 1, Supplementary Table 1), with no individual-level patient data.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand, including the supplementary table; no script transcribed any table. Table 1 and Supplementary Table 1 give group-level percentages from other publications (Karri 2024, Elhani 2024, Shiraki 2025, others, and the multicenter cohort of 185 cases from ref 22/27); these are counts without names and give no rows. The only mention of a single patient is in the Treatment section: 'In one severe and refractory case, we have referred a patient for allogeneic stem cell transplantation, who has been in drug-free remission for over 2 years after transplant.' This anecdote gives no sex, age, variant or clinical feature (the threshold the instructions use for individual-level facts), so it was not treated as an identifiable in-scope person; flagged as an uncertainty. n_patients_reported and cohort_size_as_stated left null: the 185-case cohort and the ~200 worldwide cases belong to other publications, not to a patient set described in this document. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients left null because the document describes no patients of its own. Internal inconsistencies noted: Table 1 cites the multicenter cohort as ref (27) while the text cites it as ref (22); Table 1 gives Karri 2024 n = 199 but Supplementary Table 1 gives n = 189.
